raw_text: ALERT: Vessel MV Galaxy Leader (IMO 9237307) AIS signal LOST in Red Sea near coordinates 17.2N, 41.8E. Last heading indicated normal transit through Bab-el-Mandeb approach. Possible distress situation. Multiple helicopter tracks observed in vicinity on ADS-B prior to AIS loss. Ship is Bahamas-flagged, car carrier, currently en route from Turkey to India. This matches pattern of Houthi interdiction threats against Israel-linked shipping. Will update as more information becomes available.
